mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(CONT_TAX_AMOUNT), 0) FROM CONTRACT WHERE MBR_CD_BROK = #{mbrCd} AND CONT_DTM >= CASE WHEN #{period} = 'today' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) WHEN #{period} = 'week' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') WHEN #{period} = 'year' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') WHEN #{period} = 'quarter' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q') END

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN CONT_STAT_CD = '002' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SUCCESS, SUM(CASE WHEN CONT_STAT_CD = '003' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CANCEL, SUM(CASE WHEN CONT_STAT_CD = '001' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PENDING FROM CONTRACT WHERE MBR_CD_BROK = #{mbrCd} AND CONT_DTM >= CASE WHEN #{period} = 'today' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) WHEN #{period} = 'week' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') WHEN #{period} = 'year' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') WHEN #{period} = 'quarter' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q') END

SELECT TO_CHAR(CONT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS label, SUM(CONT_TAX_AMOUNT) AS total FROM CONTRACT WHERE MBR_CD_BROK = #{mbrCd} AND CONT_DTM >= CASE WHEN #{period} = 'today' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) WHEN #{period} = 'week' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') WHEN #{period} = 'year' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') WHEN #{period} = 'quarter' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q') END GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CONT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY label

SELECT b.bucket, s.CONT_STAT_CD, COUNT(c.CONT_ID) AS count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN TO_CHAR(CONT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM') || '-' || TO_CHAR(CONT_DTM, 'W') || '주차' WHEN #{period} = 'week' THEN TO_CHAR(CONT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHEN #{period} = 'quarter' THEN TO_CHAR(CONT_DTM, 'Q') || '분기' WHEN #{period} = 'year' THEN TO_CHAR(CONT_DTM, 'MM') || '월' ELSE TO_CHAR(CONT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS bucket FROM CONTRACT WHERE MBR_CD_BROK = #{mbrCd} AND CONT_DTM >= CASE WHEN #{period} = 'today' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) WHEN #{period} = 'week' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') WHEN #{period} = 'quarter' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q') WHEN #{period} = 'year' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') END ) b CROSS JOIN ( SELECT '001' AS CONT_STAT_CD FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '002' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '003' FROM DUAL ) s LEFT JOIN CONTRACT c ON ( CASE WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN TO_CHAR(c.CONT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM') || '-' || TO_CHAR(c.CONT_DTM, 'W') || '주차' WHEN #{period} = 'week' THEN TO_CHAR(c.CONT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHEN #{period} = 'quarter' THEN TO_CHAR(c.CONT_DTM, 'Q') || '분기' WHEN #{period} = 'year' THEN TO_CHAR(c.CONT_DTM, 'MM') || '월' ELSE TO_CHAR(c.CONT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END ) = b.bucket AND c.CONT_STAT_CD = s.CONT_STAT_CD AND c.MBR_CD_BROK = #{mbrCd} AND c.CONT_DTM >= CASE WHEN #{period} = 'today' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) WHEN #{period} = 'week' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') WHEN #{period} = 'quarter' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q') WHEN #{period} = 'year' THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') END GROUP BY b.bucket, s.CONT_STAT_CD ORDER BY b.bucket, s.CONT_STAT_CD

SELECT SCD_ID, SCD_TITL_NM, TO_CHAR(SCD_STR_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SCD_STR_DTM, TO_CHAR(SCD_END_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SCD_END_DTM, SCD_LEVEL FROM SCHEDULE WHERE MBR_CD = #{mbrCd} AND SCD_STR_DTM BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') AND TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') + 6 AND SCD_DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY SCD_STR_DTM

SELECT LSTG_ID , LSTG_NM , LSTG_ADD , LSTG_ADD2 , LSTG_LEASE , LSTG_LEASE_AMT , LSTG_LEASE_M , LSTG_REG_DATE , LSTG_TYPE_SALE FROM LISTING WHERE MBR_CD = #{mbrCd} AND LSTG_REG_DATE >= SYSDATE - 7 ORDER BY LSTG_REG_DATE DESC

SELECT L.LSTG_ID, L.LSTG_NM, L.LSTG_ADD, L.LSTG_ADD2, L.LSTG_LEASE, L.LSTG_LEASE_AMT, L.LSTG_LEASE_M, L.LSTG_REG_DATE, L.LSTG_TYPE_SALE, NVL(VT.VIEW_COUNT, 0) AS VIEW_COUNT, NVL(QT.QUESTION_COUNT, 0) AS QUESTION_COUNT, NVL(VT.VIEW_COUNT, 0) + NVL(QT.QUESTION_COUNT, 0) AS TOTAL_INTERACTION FROM LISTING L LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT LSTG_ID, COUNT(*) AS VIEW_COUNT FROM LSTG_VIEW_LOG GROUP BY LSTG_ID ) VT ON L.LSTG_ID = VT.LSTG_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT LSTG_ID, COUNT(*) AS QUESTION_COUNT FROM BROKER_CHATROOM GROUP BY LSTG_ID ) QT ON L.LSTG_ID = QT.LSTG_ID WHERE L.MBR_CD = #{mbrCd} ORDER BY TOTAL_INTERACTION ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT L.LSTG_ID, L.LSTG_NM, L.LSTG_ADD, L.LSTG_ADD2, L.LSTG_LEASE, L.LSTG_LEASE_AMT, L.LSTG_LEASE_M, L.LSTG_TYPE_SALE, L.LSTG_REG_DATE, TRUNC(SYSDATE - L.LSTG_REG_DATE) AS VACANT_DAYS FROM LISTING L WHERE L.MBR_CD = #{mbrCd} AND L.LSTG_PROD_STAT = '001' ORDER BY VACANT_DAYS DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT L.LSTG_ID, L.LSTG_NM, L.LSTG_ADD, L.LSTG_ADD2, L.LSTG_TYPE_SALE, NVL(VT.VIEW_COUNT, 0) AS VIEWS, NVL(QT.QUESTION_COUNT, 0) AS INQUIRIES, NVL(VT.VIEW_COUNT, 0) + NVL(QT.QUESTION_COUNT, 0) AS TOTAL_INTERACTION FROM LISTING L LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT LSTG_ID, COUNT(*) AS VIEW_COUNT FROM LSTG_VIEW_LOG WHERE 1=1
AND TRUNC(VIEW_DTM) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND VIEW_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW')
AND VIEW_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
AND VIEW_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q')
AND VIEW_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
GROUP BY LSTG_ID ) VT ON L.LSTG_ID = VT.LSTG_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT LSTG_ID, COUNT(*) AS QUESTION_COUNT FROM BROKER_CHATROOM WHERE 1=1
AND TRUNC(CR_CRE_DTM) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND CR_CRE_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW')
AND CR_CRE_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
AND CR_CRE_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q')
AND CR_CRE_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
GROUP BY LSTG_ID ) QT ON L.LSTG_ID = QT.LSTG_ID WHERE L.MBR_CD = #{mbrCd} ORDER BY TOTAL_INTERACTION DESC
